segments.sn56.17:1.1: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn56.17:1.5: “Yaṃ kho, bhikkhu, dukkhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, avijjā;
segments.sn56.17:2.1: “Tasmātiha, bhikkhu,‘idaṃ dukkhan’ti yogo karaṇīyo … pe …‘ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā’ti yogo karaṇīyo”ti.
